stories.name: Boeing Q3 cash flow troubles
stories.blurb: Boeing's third-quarter results and weak cash flow outlook have driven analyst downgrades and a sharp stock decline.

stories.name: Boeing 737 Max 10 certification
stories.blurb: Boeing is working to get its largest 737 Max variant, the Max 10, certified by the FAA amid software delays, supply chain constraints, and production rate challenges.

stories.name: Archer-Boeing Deal
stories.blurb: Archer Aviation is acquiring Boeing subsidiaries Wisk Aero, Insitu, and SkyGrid, a deal that boosts Archer's growth prospects and stock price in the eVTOL/air taxi market.

stories.name: Boeing F/A-XX Contract
stories.blurb: Boeing has won a roughly $20 billion U.S. Navy contract to build the next-generation F/A-XX carrier-based fighter jet, ending years of delays and boosting its defense business.

stories.name: Boeing market reports
stories.blurb: A series of market research reports forecasting growth across commercial aircraft, cabin, and defense segments, with Boeing named among the leading manufacturers driving demand through 2030.

past.name: GE Aerospace stock outlook
past.blurb: A series of headlines weighing whether GE Aerospace's strong earnings and rally make its stock a buy, a sell, or overvalued versus rivals like Boeing, Lockheed Martin, and SpaceX.

past.name: Defense Stocks Surge
past.blurb: Rising government defense spending, missile stockpile initiatives, and strong earnings are driving a broad rally in defense and aerospace stocks like Lockheed Martin, RTX, and Rocket Lab.

past.name: Aerospace Q3 earnings
past.blurb: Third-quarter earnings results and investor reaction across major aerospace companies, including Boeing, GE Aerospace, Hexcel, Honeywell, RTX, and United Airlines.

past.name: Boeing 737 Max certification
past.blurb: Boeing is working through regulatory certification and production delays for its 737 Max variants while trying to stabilize output.

past.name: Boeing Regulatory & Orders Update
past.blurb: Boeing navigates FAA regulatory approvals, safety inspections, and emissions exemptions while securing new aircraft orders and deliveries across its commercial jet lineup.

events.name: Amazon Prime Air 767 crashes in Miami
Boeing Q3 EPS misses, revenue beats

5.text: Boeing is cutting about 5% of its commercial airplane workforce after slower-than-expected production increases, and October jet deliveries fell sequentially and annually, trailing Airbus. Shares dropped 25.6% over three months amid 777X certification delays, while ETFs sold a net $25.2 million of Boeing stock on Nov. 11.

8.text: Boeing is cutting about 2,500 airliner jobs because its 737 factory cannot reach 47 planes monthly until 2027 despite a $745 billion backlog; it reported 165 gross October orders, no cancellations, 49 deliveries, and backlog 6,457 vs 6,341. No certification; China Eastern signed $540 million in supplier agreements, and two jets collided in Miami; these barely bear on Boeing.

6.text: Archer beat Q3 revenue estimates but posted a wider-than-expected loss, and its Midnight aircraft won an FAA market survey certificate, not yet type certification. Its Boeing deal is nearly done, with 2027 passenger service targeted.

10.text: Northrop Grumman will not protest the Navy's F/A-XX award to Boeing, clearing a legal challenge to Boeing's win. BAE Systems reported strong 2026 results and £33bn in orders, with no direct bearing on Boeing.

13.text: ResearchAndMarkets released five market reports covering next-generation narrowbody aircraft, surveillance aircraft, UAVs, space logistics, and counter-UAS systems, forecasting growth rates up to 24.6% through 2030. Boeing is named among profiled competitors in each, but the reports contain no Boeing-specific news or developments.
